description: Full-duration matched-seed Phase Four exposure preflight. This uses the same 2000-tick configuration as the planned full campaign but only eight matched seeds. Its purpose is to measure whether sensing execution and realized locomotion co-occur often enough to make a later 30-seed paired campaign scientifically interpretable. It is calibration/exposure evidence only and must not be used to claim treatment effects, navigation, adaptation, or resource seeking.
